reports.title: The Quarter: Progress on Many Fronts

desk.headline: Revenue down 35% to $164.2m, below estimates; bitcoin price gains lift net income to $632.1m; no financial guidance
results: Revenue fell 35% to $164.2m as the average price of bitcoin mined was 37% lower than a year ago; output rose 5% to 2,247 BTC.
Net income jumped to $632.1m ($1.28 per diluted share) from $123.1m, driven by an $885.3m paper gain on bitcoin holdings, not by mining.
Costs: purchased energy rose 12% to $48.1m, energy cost per bitcoin mined was $39,674 (from $39,235); G&A fell 11% to $75.8m.
After quarter-end MARA sold 13,597 BTC for about $1.1bn and fully repaid $750m of bitcoin-backed loans; total debt is down $1.4bn (37%) this year.
Board approved a share buyback of up to $500m after quarter-end; Exaion signed a four-year $79m GPU-rental contract.

guidance.summary: MARA gives no revenue or earnings outlook. It is targeting two data-centre lease signings before year-end but warns timing could slip into 2027, and expects the Long Ridge power-plant deal to close by year-end.

points: Strategy is to earn contracted returns from its power sites: leasing to AI/data-centre customers, with bitcoin mining kept as the base business.
Lease talks with tenants are described as advanced, with Kearney the most developed site; two signings targeted before year-end.
Long Ridge (485 MW gas plant, rising to 505 MW in H1 2027) received FERC approval; a new Texas site could add up to 2 GW.
Management notes investors have grown more cautious on AI infrastructure but says demand for powered sites remains strong.
Bitcoin will keep being sold to build cash for AI projects, convertible-note puts due next year and possible buybacks.
call.source: Shareholder letter (Exhibit 99.1); no independent call coverage found

watch: Whether the two targeted data-centre leases are signed by year-end or slip into 2027.
Closing of the Long Ridge acquisition and its first contribution to earnings.
Use of the $500m buyback and cash needs for convertible-note puts in 2027, with bitcoin prices driving reported profit.
